concerns.text: Notification and booking repositories use concurrent in-memory storage rather than persistent database storage.
Privacy service uses in-memory storage for user data records and export requests.
Ledger and payment instructions services store entries in-memory rather than in persistent database tables.
Frontend components rely on mock API fallback responses when backend services are not running.
Backup and restore scripts rely on local shell dependencies like pg_dump and gzip.
Architecture decision record is concise and could expand on detailed voice latency benchmarks in future iterations.
Voice processing API contract defines core endpoints and WebSocket shapes but does not include rate-limiting headers in the spec.
